scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @script/shared build && concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @script/client dev" "pnpm --filter @script/server dev"
scripts.dev:app: pnpm --filter @script/shared build && concurrently -n client,server,worker -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @script/client dev" "pnpm --filter @script/server dev" "pnpm --filter @script/server worker"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @script/shared build && pnpm --filter @script/server build && pnpm --filter @script/client build
